ren|Mira went for lamp-oil. She is good.text: Mira went for lamp-oil. She is good at gossip. Bad at clocks.

ren|She might have stopped at the canal.speaker: ren
ren|She might have stopped at the canal.text: She might have stopped at the canal bridge. She always stops at the canal bridge.
